notes: Opt-in scoped request subscription with an Effect HTTP body decoder; owned Option result distinguishes absent from typed unavailable/incomplete errors. Plain snapshots and history retain no bodies. Use message.arrayBuffer; stock WebKit cannot report original bytes. Chromium requires complete event-carried bytes for an empty payload and refuses empty fallback reports.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
